reviews.comment: Just for her lecturing skills alone she is an amazing professor extremely good at teaching. Her office hours are great. Her tests are mostly straightforward and her review videos helped me the most out of anything. I will say though certain things people ask(mostly like about past material when we're learning new)she just refuses to answer but

She is a really good prof and explains everything very clearly. If she didn't have to leave in the middle of the sem I would prob have a better grade and understand things even better because the second she left i've done worse. Granted she did have a baby but it's frustrating because she really is an amazing prof lol.

Taken Fall 2025. My favorite professor hands-down. Her lectures were so great and she cares so much about every student. She offers so much of her time outside of class to help you out. It truly felt like if I did bad, it was entirely on me. I WISH I had her for 258. Yes, she's harder than other professors. That being said, an A is VERY doable.

Dr. Michaudel was phenomenal. Her lectures were easy to understand and she broke down hard concepts well. Go to her office hours as much as possible. Each lecture you get a worksheet that adds 1 point to your exam grade for completion and another .5 points if you get the question she grades right. Exams were hard but doable if you study enough.

Halfway through the semester, she started talking in complete jargon which I could hardly understand. I began to get more lost from there. She acts like all of her students have a PhD, and has too big of an ego for my taste, but other than that, very informative lectures. Very hard exams, and you need to actually know the content if you take her

Professor Michaudel (formerly deGruyter) is the best professor I have had in college. She helped me overcome the challenge of organic chemistry providing help and personal encouragement at every turn. She thinks so highly of her students, and treats them like it. She is a naturally gifted lecturer, and I am thankful to have been in her class.

Dr. Michaudel was an incredible professor! Each test has enough extra credit (based on homework completion) to knock you up a whole letter grade, but they're definitely needed because the tests can be very challenging (tests 3 and 4 particularly). She also posts videos for lectures and worksheet keys. Postlabs are annoying, but the DQs are easy.

Professor Michaudel was caring and really made organic chemistry enjoyable for me. This was by no means an easy class, but I learned a lot from the professor, and she made the class a great experience. Lab is always bad, so be prepared. Go to office hours if you want to do well (I LOVED THE ONLINE sessions)

SHE IS THE BEST OCHEM PROF AT TAMU BY FAR ,but if you want an easy A and don't care about having a deep understanding of ochem take the easier option. (My friends that have easier prof's know wayyy less than me and easily got an A in their classes) I wish ochem was a bit more standardized to make things fair.

Professor Michaudel is probably the best professor you can get. She is definitely by no means easy and would argue that her test are on the harder side but the curves make up for it. She is very supportive  and is very accessible outside of class. Organic chemistry is hard but with the right study habits and her help it was a great experience!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: genuinely such a caring professor. she truly wants her students to succeed and can be a bit blunt sometimes but it's all love. i wish she gave us more practice problems because it sometimes didnt feel like enough, but the extra credit definitely made up for it.

Her lectures are good to follow and comprehend. She posts lecture recordings for all lectures, gives generous extra credit on exams although that balances the cutoff being a 90 instead of an 85, and responds to emails very quickly. I genuinely learned so much throughout the course and all through the resources she provided without external help.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lectures are fine, but go veryyy fast paced. Exams are MUCH harder than other professors- no cheat sheets, all free response, and VERY in depth- she loves to trick you. Good extra credit but the work sheets are long and hard. Yes, i'm better at o chem than my friends with other profs, but they have an A and I don't. Prepares you, but at what cost?
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Best prof at a&m by far. Her lectures are extremely engaging. She does an amazing job at helping you actually know and feel confident in what you are doing. Provides tons of extra credit throughout the semester. Do not even consider taking this class with anybody else.

The semester obviously isn't over yet but my ochem grade is the best grade I've had since coming to A&M. I can sincerely say that her lectures are very easy to comprehend, she posts recordings of her lectures for those who missed her class or need to rewatch her lecture to have a better understanding.

She's not just the best CHEM 227 professor, but one of the best on campus. She offered more of her time than all of my other professors combined. If you attend the practice sessions, take meaningful notes, and spend time studying for exams, you will do very well.

Absolutely loved her. She offers TONS of help throughout the week with practice sessions and answers emails around the clock and never makes you feel stupid for any questions you have. She can be a savage but its all love. Attend everything you can and put in the work. She's great but its still ochem and she can only help if you work for it

I absolutely loved taking OCHEM with her; her lectures were engaging and she stayed after class almost every time to answer any questions we might've had. She had practice sessions Mondays & Fridays, which were super helpful for exams. Just put in the work and you'll succeed in this course. Hands down, she was one of the best professors I've had!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. deGruyter is the best professor I have ever had. She is so accessible to her students and responds very fast for anything. She truly cares about your grade and does her best to get you the grade that you want. She is very passionate about the subject too which makes it so easy to follow along. Would 100% recommend taking her. She made ochem fun

Dr deGruyter was my favorite professor this semester while being my only B. Her lectures are super engaging and her guided notes actually help so much. her tests are fair and have extra credit and the average was good for ochem. Also a bonus that she's pretty cute
Best chemistry professor you will have. Provides guided notes throughout lectures making things easier to understand. She held review sessions before tests which were very beneficial too.
Dr. deGruyeter was amazing! I took CHEM 222 not 227 but her lectures were phenomenal, tests had plenty of extra credit and notes were very helpful.

Dr. deGruyter is by far the best professor I have ever had. She made OCHEM 1 very approachable and put in hours of work outside of class creating supplemental review sheets and practice exams. She is the most accessible and hard working professor I have ever had.

Dr. D was one of the best professors I've ever had. She had amazing lectures that were extremely straightforward and informative. Dr. D made herself available as much as humanly possible in order to help students learn outside of class. The review sessions absolutely made a difference in the grade I received. She made 227 one of my easiest classes!

dr. d is PHENOMENAL! if i could take 228 with her i would. she has practice sessions and holds office hours pretty much everyday & the worksheets/practice exams she posts are so helpful for studying for her exams. if you want to understand ochem do yourself a favor and take her! not an easy A but you won't regret it! ily justine

If you don't pass with her, you won't pass with anyone. She goes well beyond what's expected of her, however, I would highly recommend going through the material before even stepping into class. This course gets tough because of the amount of information. If you get familiar with the material beforehand, this course should become a breeze.

no one does it like dr.d. shes hot, funny, amazing teacher, and super accessible. if you have to take ochem definitely take w her. go to practice sessions, office hours, and lectures and you will do fine (if you study outside of class & do practice problems). if you ever have any questions she usually responds within a few hours too.

Dr. D is an absolute goat. Ochem in general is pretty difficult, but she makes it more interesting and understandable. She hosts lots and lots of extra practice, such as practice sessions on Monday (online) and in-person office hour review (Friday). Her tests are very fair and make sure to attend class. Definitely recommend taking her if possible.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is AMAZING! Gives so much practice material so that you are prepared for every exam. She is also the best professor I've ever had, she remembers all of her student's names. TAKE HER

Best professor I have had so far in my college life. Gives SO MUCH outside help in regards to office hours and practice sessions. Extremely responsive to emails. Has informative enthusiastic lectures.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: So wish she taught chem 228 also. She is great!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Best professor I've ever had. Ever. Explains everything very clearly in an easy to understand way. Her lectures are very organized. But the key to doing well in any real science class is practice and application. I highly recommend office hours and definitely the practice sessions. I wish she taught CHEM 228. I would 100% take her class.

Dr. D's class was not easy and I have to attend all of her help session to get a good grade, but it was worth it. In my opinion, Dr. D's lectures materials were fine but some of the content was not very clear. Reading the materials she provide AND search online / read the textbook helps me to get a good result. One of the best OCHEM prof. at TAMU.

She is by far one of the best professors I have had. The class is hard but she makes sure you are given all the material necessary to succeed and is insanely helpful outside of class if you have questions or need clarity on the topic.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Super nice and helpful. Very responsive to email. Office hours, practice sessions, and lectures were very helpful. She makes you want to learn and makes it super interesting. She learned everyone's name and was super personal. The exams were slightly easier than the practice sessions. She was super fair with grading. Read the book before class.

This course is definitely lecture heavy, however she provides you all the material you will need to succeed. She provides numerous opportunities for you to get the help you need (such as office hours, practice sessions, and review sessions.) I am not a chem minded person, however I enjoyed the course. Exams are used to check ifyou mastered concepts
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. D is hands down a great professor. I've never seen a professor that actually cared as much as she does. If you rate her lower than a 5 then you aren't taking the NUMEROUS opportunities she gives outside of class to work with you! Good job Dr. D!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. D is hands down one of the best professors I've had at A&M. She truly goes above and beyond with extra resources and practice sessions because she really cares about her students succeeding. The lecture material can be heavy, and the tests do count for a lot, but she gives you every opportunity to get the material down.

Dr.D has probably been the best professor I have had. Ochem is about applying yourself, so attend ALL extra learning activities. Pros: guided notes, no reading, practice sessions, mock exams, office hours (basically an interactive lecture), recorded lectures, Very caring and funny. Cons: Owl hw, can go fast through lecture, test grade heavy

Anybody rating less than a 5 for this professor is simply regretful for not taking advantage of the MANY opportunities Dr. D provides. Dr. D is and probably will be the best professor I ever have, easy. There is nothing MORE you can ask from her. This is O-CHEM : Lectures should not be your first time seeing the material if you want a good grade.

Dr. D was so easy to reach and was 100% wiling to work WITH you in order to achieve your goals. Answers emails within a day and hosts weekly help sessions and office hours. Be prepared to know everything conceptually in order to apply on the test- they will make you think. KEEP UP with material. DO NOT fall behind- everything builds on each other.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. D is by far the best chemistry professor I have ever had. She is so nice, will work with you any time you need, e-mails back fast and really puts in time and dedication to her job. I highly recommend this prof to anyone who really wants to learn about O-Chem and not just skim by it.

I would recommend attending her in-person office hours and practice sessions to help solidify the material since there is ALOT to learn in class and lectures go fast. She responds quickly to emails and is passionate about teaching. She makes lectures like a performance. Absolutely adore her, and wish I could take her for OCHEM2. HIGHLY recommend!

I absolutely loved Dr. d as a person. Shes very genuine and cares about her students. My only complaint was how fast she went through the material during lectures. Felt like you were supposed to know it already. Exams make up most of your grade and are all open response. The questions were extremely difficult compared to homework, class, etc.

I really liked deGruyter as a person, but I couldnt keep up with her. She goes fast through the topics. Her example problems are far easier than the exams. I thought I knew the material, but did awful on the exams and dropped. Her teaching style just didnt work for me, but it seems others love her. Overall, not a bad choice. Shes extremely nice.

Best professor you could take. She managed to make organic chemistry seem easy! She will make so much time and put in so much effort to help you understand the content. Always available as long as you make the effort to reach out. TAKE HER IF YOU NEED OCHEM
The single better professor Ive taken at any university Ive been at. You would be mad to choose anyone else.

This was by far the best prof I ever had the chance of taking at TAMU. She really cares about your grade and whether or not you pass the class. She even hosts study sessions outside of class several times a week to help with the material covered in that weeks lectures! Dr. d helped me actually enjoy OChem. Take her if you can.

Take this professor if possible. She truly cares about your education and strives for you to keep on learning. One thing is she won't curve exams but rather she gives opportunities for extra credit on exams and lowers grade cut offs. She uses guided notes, extra credit in class, practice sessions, and free response exams. Truly the best prof !
Amazing professor that tries her best for you to actually understand the material instead of making you memorize every reaction. 100% recommend. Just show up, take note, and attend practice session.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is amazing! Gives fast lectures but provides a guided note sheet to follow. All free response tests. Holds in depth review sessions and office hours. AND she gives extra credit during class! She only teaches 227 currently, not 228 yet.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures
